served_mismatch: The served HR 1.05 (95% CI 0.93 to 1.19), with counts 541 versus 517, describes the secondary three-component composite of cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction and nonfatal stroke. The primary MACE composite also includes coronary revascularization and hospitalization for unstable angina; its HR is 0.99 (95% CI 0.90-1.09), with 785 versus 795 events. The held registry names the analysis population Full Analysis Set, without explicitly equating it to intention-to-treat.

candidate_rejections.why: This estimate concerns the secondary three-component CV composite rather than the primary MACE composite. Reject the served extraction, retain the trial and bind the primary MACE result.

entry_population_matches_question.why: The trial enrolled statin-treated participants at high cardiovascular risk; registry eligibility specifies adults aged at least 18 years. Explicit ITT equivalence is not stated.
